seo.description: Choose our Magical Meghalaya Tour Package to see waterfalls, living root bridges, caverns, and trekking routes to get a close look at nature.

items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast
Sightseeing

content.text: Northeast India is an adventure sought for adventurers, with its spinning hills, valleys, magical waterfalls, culture, traditions, and life celebrations. A trip to this region of India should be the priority for young travellers.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Witness the beautiful view of Umiam lake on the way to Shillong
Ward's Lake and Lady Hydari Park are worth seeing
Wander around the famous Police Bazar, Don Bosco Museum for an evening break
The Laitlum Canyons and Shillong Peak are both worth visiting
Visit the amazing Balancing Rock and Mawphlang forest
Take a visit to Cherrapunji, the second-most wettest city on the planet
Visit the Air Force Museum, Nohsngithiang Falls, Wah Kaba Falls, Elephant Falls, and Krang Suri Falls
Mawsmai Cave and Mawjymbuin Cave are the majestic caves to explore
Take a fascinating tour of Guwahati's Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum, Brahmaputra Cruise, and markets

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati- Mini Shillong Trip
items: You will be welcomed upon arrival at Guwahati Airport or Railway Station and transported to Shillong.
On the way, you can catch the site of the enchantingly mannered Barapani aka Umiam Lake.
Also see the stunning Ward's Lake and the Golf Course Museum, which houses Shillong's best relics, traditional attire, and native equipment.
Evenings can be used to explore the area, so shopping at the Police Bazar would be enjoyable and beneficial.
Check in at your hotel in Shillong.

days.title: Day 2 : Visit to Laitlum Canyons
items: Get through with breakfast and be ready for the mesmerizing tour to the Grand Canyons- Laitlum Canyons.
Enjoy the untrodden beauty of the Canyons and the lush green beauty spreading wide and leading to a small village.
Refresh yourself in one of the least crowded and unique hilly destinations.
Your next refreshing stop would be the Shillong Peak.
Located at a high point almost 6449 ft and 1965 m above sea level lies the beautiful peak that lets you get the view of the entire Shillong city.
After the expedition of the hills, you will be witnessing the Elephant Falls.
A unique three staired fall being unfathomably beautiful.
Drive to shillong and have a restful sleep in your hotel.

days.title: Day 3 : DAY-3: Visit to Dawki- Mawlynnong
items: Following the breakfast, get ready to visit Dawki
Witness the crystal clear Umngot river and enjoy a boat ride on it.
You will witness the river with clear blue water surrounded by all green and beautiful nature.
Enjoy the shimmering, colorful beauty.
Visit to the Indo-Bangladesh Border would be the last spot for the day.
Later check in at your hotel in Mawlynnong.

days.title: Day 4 : Mawlynnong to Cherrapunjee
items: After breakfast, get all set for a visit to Mawlynnong Village, which was named Asia's cleanest village by 'Discover India Magazine'.
The Living Root Bridge, created by tangles of plant roots, is a natural wonder known as the Balancing Rock.
In the evening, drive to Cherrapunjee hotel.

days.title: Day 5 : Exploring Cherrapunjee
items: Prepare to explore the local surroundings of Cherrapunjee, the world's wettest region, after breakfast.
The beautiful Cherrapunjee Falls, notably the Nohsngithiang Falls (Seven Sisters Falls), Wah Kaba Falls, and Nohkalikai Falls, would be the next stop.
Then take a leisurely walk into Mawsmai Cave and the Eco Park, a limestone cave.
Evenings are free for you to visit the Air Force Museum, which has a collection of antique planes, as well as the serene Ramakrishna Mission Ashrama and local markets.
Return back to the hotel at Cherrapunjee, where you will spend the night.

days.title: Day 6 : Cherrapunjee to Mawsynram
items: Get ready for the journey to Mawsynram after having a tummy full breakfast.
On the way, a visit to the hallowed forest of Mawphlang will be worthwhile.
The forest owns astonishing forms of life, species of flowers, birds, animals ,insects and plants.
Being an ideal stop for nature lovers, the place offers you to indulge into nature photography providing the best and unique natural escapes of Khasi hills.
Next you can witness the Mawjymbuin Cave which is shaped into the Shivlinga along with a top known as Symper Rock.
Drive back for an overnight stay at Shillong.

days.title: Day 7 : Visit to Guwahati
items: Drive to Guwahati for a day of sightseeing after breakfast.
To begin, go to the Sankardev Kalakshetra Science Museum, which represents Assam's cultural diversity.
The Brahmaputra Cruise and Dolphin Sighting on the Bridge are both available along the way.
Local markets visit would suffice for the evening.
Thereafter check in at your hotel in Guwahati.

days.title: Day 8 : Departure
items: Check out of the hotel following the breakfast.
A drive to Guwahati Airport or Railway Station will end the tour.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
